exceptions.title: handles interactions
exceptions.reason: The case presses Enter on the trigger to open the menu. The trigger of Vase UI has no press yet.

exceptions.title: disabled state
exceptions.reason: The case presses Enter and Space on a disabled trigger, and it expects that the menu stays closed. The trigger of Vase UI has no press yet, so the case cannot fail.
Each case of the block renders `Popover.Trigger` and the other parts of Popover from the entry point of Popover. Vase UI does not have that entry point.
